verdict.rationale: Fedora's own Workstation page documents a global search launcher: press the Super key and type to search. That is a single marketing line, though. It does not say which content types are searched or how fast results appear, and nothing independent confirms it. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that files, apps and settings are all searchable; evidence of instant results; detailed first-party docs; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can search for files, apps, and settings instantly from a global search launcher

citations.quote: Press the Super key and just type to search for what you need.
